scenes.audio_narration: Key features include: GPU-Accelerated Rendering, Rust Core Engine, Collaborative CRDT Editing, Native AI Chat.

scenes.google_flow_prompt: High quality graphical breakdown card displaying Pros vs Cons for Zed Editor.
scenes.audio_narration: On the pros side: Written in Rust with GPU acceleration for 120 FPS rendering, Instant startup time with near-zero lag, Built-in multiplayer pair programming tools, Native AI integration (Claude, OpenAI, Ollama). On the cons side: Smaller extension ecosystem compared to VS Code, Linux and Windows support newer than macOS release, Fewer legacy plugin integrations.
